confidence: Low. Documents establish several motives, a poison source, a private drink route, and camera conditions, but no crime or individualized use is yet demonstrated.
plausibility_notes: Donor coercion credibly supplies multiple motives; resignation and service payment stand out as specific stakes.
A historical bottle retaining lethal contents is a theatrical convention and a conspicuous potential weapon; its continued danger is not yet established.
Separate show-control and security circuits, a canceled blackout, and a continuing toast can coherently prevent conflating performance with surveillance.
The unusually complete paper trail and notes anticipate investigative questions; usable at a scripted dinner but conspicuously curated.
Manager identification is not yet explicit enough to assume every reference means Brie; scores treat the service route as provisional.
